title: T. T. Brown apparatus left in the Eureka garage
summary: Clas Svahn tells of T. T. Brown apparatus left in the Eureka garage, about unspecified at Eureka, California, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

plain: Clas Svahn, a researcher who collects UFO records, says that a group called the Borderland Society, based in Eureka, California, had ties to Townsend Brown, an inventor who patented a device he called an electrokinetic generator and is the subject of a book called The Man Who Mastered Gravity. Svahn says the group still had some of Brown's apparatus in its garage, which he could not bring away. If true, it would mean pieces of Brown's claimed anti-gravity work still sit in a garage.
